facts.fact: Kayla 眼角瞥见与 Aaron 极像的男人，恐慌瞬间攫住

facts.fact: 上一次恐慌发作恰在一年前，她原以为自己已过去

facts.anchor: It’s like your body is convinced it’s dying, and the harder you try to breathe, the more the air won’t come
